blends.name: Yazing Cyborg Thief
blends.desc:
This is a limited editon mythic NFT (max min = 10) and is only available in exchange for a Yazing Gold Token.  

These NFTs can be staked to earn extra LOOT at https://farms.yazing.com and may available for staking in wombat in future seasons.

All 10 Mints are pre-minted.  Max 2 Per Account - Good Luck.

If you don't have the required tokens from using Yazing.com, you can check the secondary market.

Copper Tokens - https://neftyblocks.com/marketplace/listing?collection_name=yazingdotcom&page=1&schema_name=rewards&sort=price&order=asc&data:text.variant=token&data:text.rarity=common
